declarations.docstring: For an indecomposable retract of a finite biproduct of indecomposables, one component of the retract inclusion is an isomorphism.
An indecomposable retract of a finite biproduct of indecomposable objects is isomorphic to one of its summands.
An isomorphism between finite biproducts of indecomposables matches every source summand with an isomorphic target summand.
Separates a selected term of a finite biproduct from the complementary family as a binary biproduct.
The first binary projection through the splitting isomorphism is the projection onto the selected biproduct component.
Postcomposing the transported first binary projection agrees with postcomposing the selected biproduct projection.
The first binary inclusion transported through the inverse splitting isomorphism is the selected biproduct inclusion.
Precomposing with the transported first binary inclusion agrees with precomposing with the selected biproduct inclusion.
